notes: SCREEN MEETS LUMI. Since the LUMI hardware shows exactly two colors (root + in-scale), the app can now meet it halfway: turn on TWO-COLOR MODE (Settings > MIDI, under the LUMI color pickers) and the on-screen keyboard paints its keys with the SAME two colors being pushed to the keybed — root keys in your root color, every other in-scale key in your scale color. Dial the two pickers until the physical keys look right, flip the toggle, and screen and LUMI finally agree.
